as_told.title: Pat Price's death and disappearance in an unmarked ambulance

plain: A man named Pat Price, part of the psychic research circle around the researcher Hal Puthoff, died in 1975 in a way that people who were there describe differently from the published account. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant from the same world, passes on what he heard from them: the death came in Washington DC, an unmarked ambulance was involved, and years later the head of security said, "Pat Price died and we haven't heard from him since." Buchanan tells it to suggest the official story of the death is not the whole story.
